rejection_findings.finding: The body wrongly predicates insatiability of both the tyrannized city and the tyrannical soul; the Greek and accepted evidence assign insatiability specifically to the tyrannical soul.

revisions.title: Tyranny as enslavement
revisions.body: Here the city and the tyrannical soul reverse the appearance of command. The tyrannized city is poor, while the tyrannical soul is poor and insatiable; the soul is also dragged by turmoil and regret. The prison image completes the reversal: the tyrant is bound by fears and desires, confined and unable to live as free men do. What looks like mastery is enslavement.
